source_caption_text:
Natalie Nunn really pulled an Uno reverse for Halloween and dressed up as North West 😭😂🎃

Via: @realmissnatalienunn 
📸: @jm.edia 

The costume came after North transformed into Natalie with a black bob, a “CEO Baddies” chain and a prosthetic chin. North revealed her look in a video lip-syncing to Nicki Minaj’s Natalie Nunn reference on Lil Uzi Vert’s “Endless Fashion.” 

Natalie returned the favor with bright blue pigtails, a graphic T-shirt and a spiked bracelet, recreating North’s style. She even used North’s song “Piercing on My Hand” for the reveal and copied her hand-over-mouth pose 😭 

Kim Kardashian had already joined in by dressing as her daughter too, complete with blue hair and faux piercings. North went as Natalie, while Natalie and Kim both went as North. Halloween turned into a whole costume exchange 😂💀 

Who had the best recreation? 👀
